properties.name: The tool half moved to tools/skills_tools.rs, where every other tool module already lives; skills.rs keeps the compiled-in skill DATA and no longer imports ReflowService. That import was the cycle edge — service called skills::catalogue() for its own instructions while skills implemented tools on the service. `Self::skills_router()` was ALREADY summed in ReflowService::new alongside the rest, so only the file placement disagreed with the intended shape. All 152 toolsnaps match: the served surface is unchanged.
